import importlib
import pathlib
import sys
import unittest

import torch


SOURCE_ROOT = pathlib.Path("/fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_c117_hyperbolic_item_semantic_id")
sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE_ROOT))
geometry = importlib.import_module("model.hyperbolic")
from model.model import RQVAE


class HyperbolicGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_distance_gradcheck_and_central_finite_difference(self):
        # Interior, non-collinear double-precision points avoid all clamps.
        x = torch.tensor([[0.12, -0.08, 0.05]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.04, 0.09, 0.11]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        self.assertTrue(torch.autograd.gradcheck(
            lambda a, b: geometry.hyperbolic_distance(a, b), (x, y),
            eps=1e-6, atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-4))

        loss = geometry.hyperbolic_distance(x, y).square().sum()
        gx, gy = torch.autograd.grad(loss, (x, y))
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(gx).all().item())
        self.assertGreater(gx.norm().item(), 1e-7)
        h = 1e-6
        with torch.no_grad():
            xp, xm = x.detach().clone(), x.detach().clone()
            xp[0, 1] += h
            xm[0, 1] -= h
            fd = (geometry.hyperbolic_distance(xp, y.detach()).square().sum()
                  - geometry.hyperbolic_distance(xm, y.detach()).square().sum()) / (2*h)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(gx[0, 1].item(), fd.item(), delta=2e-5)

    def test_exp_log_and_distance_backpropagate(self):
        tangent = torch.tensor([[0.21, -0.13, 0.07]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        point = geometry.exp_0(tangent)
        recovered = geometry.log_0(point)
        objective = recovered.square().sum() + geometry.hyperbolic_distance(
            point, torch.tensor([[0.03, 0.08, -0.02]], dtype=torch.double)).square().sum()
        grad, = torch.autograd.grad(objective, tangent)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(point).all().item())

        self.assertGreater(grad.norm().item(), 1e-7)

    def test_actual_rqvae_training_loss_updates_encoder_and_geometry_codebook(self):
        torch.manual_seed(231)
        class Config:
            hidden_sizes = (7,)
            codebook_dim = 3
            dropout = 0.0
            geometry = "hyperbolic"
            codebook_num = 2
            codebook_size = (4, 4)
            vq_type = "vq"
            beta = 0.25
            sk_epsilon = -1.0
            sk_iters = -1

        model = RQVAE(Config(), in_dim=5)
        model.train()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for layer in model.rq.vq_layers:
                layer.embed.weight.copy_(torch.tensor([
                    [-0.35, 0.02, 0.01], [-0.08, 0.04, -0.03],
                    [0.11, -0.07, 0.05], [0.31, 0.09, -0.04]
                ]))
        batch = torch.tensor([[0.8, -0.2, 0.4, 0.1, -0.6],
                              [-0.3, 0.7, 0.2, -0.5, 0.4],
                              [0.1, 0.3, -0.8, 0.6, 0.2],
                              [-0.7, -0.1, 0.5, 0.2, 0.9]], dtype=torch.float32)
        before = {name: p.detach().clone() for name, p in model.named_parameters()}
        reconstructed, quant_loss, _, tokens = model(batch)
        loss, _ = model.compute_loss(batch, reconstructed, quant_loss)
        self.assertEqual(tuple(tokens.shape), (4, 2))
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(loss).item())
        loss.backward()
        encoder = model.encoder.mlp[1].weight
        self.assertIsNotNone(encoder.grad)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(encoder.grad).all().item())
        self.assertGreater(encoder.grad.norm().item(), 1e-8)
        changed_codebooks = 0
        for i, layer in enumerate(model.rq.vq_layers):
            grad = layer.embed.weight.grad
            self.assertIsNotNone(grad)
            self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(grad).all().item())
            self.assertGreater(grad.norm().item(), 1e-8)
            optimizer = torch.optim.SGD([layer.embed.weight], lr=0.05)
            optimizer.step()
            changed_codebooks += int(not torch.equal(before[f"rq.vq_layers.{i}.embed.weight"], layer.embed.weight))
        self.assertEqual(changed_codebooks, 2)
        opt = torch.optim.SGD(model.encoder.parameters(), lr=0.05)
        opt.step()
        self.assertFalse(torch.equal(before["encoder.mlp.1.weight"], encoder))

    def test_nan_and_intentionally_disconnected_graph_are_detected(self):
        nan_point = torch.tensor([[float("nan"), 0.0]], dtype=torch.double)
        bad_distance = geometry.hyperbolic_distance(nan_point, torch.zeros_like(nan_point))
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(bad_distance).all().item())

        connected = torch.tensor([0.2, -0.1], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        disconnected = connected.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
        result = geometry.hyperbolic_distance(geometry.exp_0(connected),
                                              torch.tensor([[0.0, 0.3]], dtype=torch.double)).sum()
        grad, = torch.autograd.grad(result, connected)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(grad).all().item())
        self.assertGreater(grad.norm().item(), 1e-8)
        unrelated = geometry.hyperbolic_distance(geometry.exp_0(disconnected.detach()),
                                                 torch.tensor([[0.0, 0.3]], dtype=torch.double)).sum()
        self.assertIsNone(torch.autograd.grad(unrelated, disconnected, allow_unused=True)[0])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
